findings.summary: GitHub issue 401 body is the create_issue_branch.py boilerplate and does not restate packet acceptance criteria. Machine-readable evidence on the candidate tree is complete without that body.

Prep validator requires the current branch name to equal issue/401-prepare-ls-01-executable-manifest-amendment-inpu, matching the LS-00 packet-local branch bind pattern. That is correct for this candidate and is not a development-merge unlock.
